title: Edits
description: edits/organisations.json: hand-maintained facts merged last into organisations.json.

organisation.description: Organisation id → fields to set. Any organisation.schema.json field except id, source and registered_label; label and identifier merge per key, alias and same_as are unions, everything else overrides. An id the registers lack is created; for a Swedish number an empty object is enough.

ignore.description: Strings seen in source metadata that are not organisations and not data sources.
